name: dispute-pack
title: Deduction dispute review pack
for_each: select id,reference from deductions order by reference

sections.title: Evidence index
sections.note: References only. Review originals and assemble attachments separately before submitting.
sections.sql: select kind,reference,actor from evidence where deduction_id=$1 order by kind,reference

sections.title: Notes
sections.sql: select body,actor,created_at from notes where deduction_id=$1 order by created_at

name: recovery-statement
title: Recovery reconciliation statement
for_each: select id,reference from deductions order by reference

sections.title: Recorded recoveries
sections.sql: select reference,received_on,amount_cents,actor from recoveries where deduction_id=$1 order by received_on

name: root-cause-review
title: Root cause review
for_each: select id,reference from deductions order by reference

sections.title: Deduction
sections.sql: select reference,retailer,reason,owner,state from deduction_position where id=$1

sections.title: Corrective actions
sections.sql: select title,owner,due_on,closed_on,proof from actions where deduction_id=$1 order by due_on
